name: Emilia
source:
The main heroine. Emilia is a half-elf who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election making her 42nd King of Lugnica. Among the half breeds and other discriminated or disfranchised races and people in Luginca, she is seen as their hope for a better future due to her ideal of better social equality. She always regards Subaru as a mischievous child who needs to be taken care of. Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though Emilia herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving Pack to take care of her clothes and hair.
